In a matrix representation of an operator $A$, the action of the Hermitian conjugation operation is to take the matrix of $A$ to the conjugate-transpose matrix, $A^{\dagger} \equiv\left(A^{*}\right)^{T}$, where the * indicates complex conjugation, and $T$ indicates the transpose operation.
For example, we have

$$
\left[\begin{array}{cc}
1+3 i & 2 i  \tag{2.34}\\
1+i & 1-4 i
\end{array}\right]^{\dagger}=\left[\begin{array}{cc}
1-3 i & 1-i \\
-2 i & 1+4 i
\end{array}\right]
$$
